description: Use when an agent needs platform-level context before drilling into individual markets: one row per platform (Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, Myriad, Limitless, Predict, Opinion, Gemini) carrying 24h notional volume, active event and market counts, and that platform's category mix. Takes no parameters and returns the whole picture in one small response, which makes it the cheapest way to answer 'how big is X relative to Y' or 'which platform covers this topic'. Volumes are in each platform's native units — Manifold reports play-money mana, not USD — so do not sum across platforms without saying so.
name: get_summary
title: Per-platform summary
